# Nicole Farhi Mercato Mall

> Nicole Farhi is a British fashion label known for understated ready-to-wear pieces. Its boutique sits inside Mercato Mall on Jumeirah Beach Road, a shopping centre that opened in 2002 and is styled after an Italian Renaissance town, with a glazed central atrium over its main arcade. Mercato carries around 90 shops across some 22,900 square metres of leasable space and serves the surrounding Jumeirah neighbourhood.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project covered a Nicole Farhi fashion boutique at Mercato Mall, the Italian Renaissance-styled shopping centre on Jumeirah Beach Road in Dubai. Delivered for Binhendi Enterprises, the work focused on the design stage of the store's fit-out. MENASCO produced the MEP fit-out design, preparing the building services design for the retail unit ahead of installation.
